title: Chat thought stream: live steps in the chat
summary: While Praxis works on a reply, its steps now appear in the chat as they happen. When the reply lands they fold into one line you can expand, and the thought stream box is gone from the main viewer. The turn shown is scripted, so its steps are sample text. [redacted] marks a planted bridge token, operator grant and credential that were removed before the step left Praxis. The N badge on the phone is the development server's indicator.

screens.title: Chat during a long turn, steps appearing live (desktop)
screens.notes: Five steps are done and the sixth is running, in order, with the elapsed time beside the status. The italic line is the model's own reasoning text, which appears only when the session exposes some.

screens.title: Chat during a long turn, steps appearing live (phone)
screens.notes: The same running turn at phone width. Long paths wrap inside the panel, and the newest step stays in view above the composer.

screens.title: Chat after the reply, steps collapsed to one line (desktop)
screens.notes: The steps fold into one line above the reply. It states the measured duration and the step count: Worked for 5s, 6 steps (5306 ms measured).

screens.title: Chat after the reply, steps collapsed to one line (phone)
screens.notes: The same collapsed line at phone width, Worked for 2s, 6 steps (2526 ms measured). The line is a 44px tap target.

screens.title: The collapsed line expanded (desktop)
screens.notes: Opening the line lists the same six steps in the same order. The reply stays directly below them.

screens.title: The collapsed line expanded (phone)
screens.notes: The expanded list at phone width, with no sideways scrolling. The reply is below the fold of this view.

screens.title: Main viewer left column without the thought stream box (desktop)
screens.notes: The core is thinking and has a live trace, and neither the thought stream box nor its modal appears. The token chip reads unavailable because this test stack has no usage record for the activity.

screens.title: Main viewer left column without the thought stream box (phone)
screens.notes: The same state at phone width, where the core column stacks above the chat. No thought stream box appears.
